description:
Selectively forget (delete) accumulated knowledge entries. Like a brain pruning bad memories — remove outdated, incorrect, or irrelevant session entries to keep the knowledge base clean and relevant.

Forget modes:
- **By project**: Clear all knowledge for a specific project
- **By category**: Remove entries matching a category (e.g. 'debugging')
- **By age**: Forget entries older than N days
- **Full reset**: Wipe everything (requires confirm_all=true)

⚠️ This permanently deletes ledger entries. Handoff state is preserved unless explicitly cleared.

category.description: Optional: only forget entries in this category (e.g. 'debugging', 'resume').

clear_handoff.description: Also clear the handoff (live state) for this project. Default: false.

confirm_all.description: Set to true to confirm wiping ALL entries for the project (safety flag).

dry_run.description: If true, only count what would be deleted without actually deleting. Default: false.

older_than_days.description: Optional: only forget entries older than this many days.

project.description: Project to forget entries for. Required unless using confirm_all.

name: knowledge_forget
